notes: The chain is written to Hammam. The anecdote («قدم علينا أبو داود الأعمى فجعل يقول حدثنا البراء») and Qatada's «كذب» are in the scene or commentary, not a route.
Whether Abu Dawud al-A'ma or the Companions he names (البراء، زيد بن أرقم) is the last link cannot be settled from the text (rule 11): none is added.
